_sources.workload.site_names: T14-QUALIFY-R5: five normal accounts use woodcutting.falador_west.n with in-site Starts from qualify-1102/start-selection-v2/selection.json and a distinct five-tree route matching. Fifteen oak accounts use woodcutting.dwarven_mine, the nearest distinct authored oak site proved to reach its oak resources and Falador West bank. The closer Taverley SE and Druids Circle 2 sites have bank-reachable Starts but no reachable owned oaks in the 289 pack; Falador West 2 failed the complete bank-route audit. See qualify-1102/site-probe-dwarven_mine/result.json and site-access-dwarven_mine/result.json. Start (3007,3411,0), radius 12, reaches three selected-content oaks. The shared outer bound remains x=2840..3065,z=3262..3527. Main's Chance ruling excludes event-derived movement from the workload route proof but not fault recovery or ordinary Gatherer travel. Death, stall, missed-work, transport and memory gates are unchanged.
_sources.workload.food: The selected Dwarven Mine Start has zero aggressive-envelope intersections in its oak radius-12 square, with a static nearest-envelope margin of 27 tiles (qualify-1102/site-probe-dwarven_mine/result.json). Lobster item 379 heals 12 Hitpoints in selected 289 content. Seed one Lobster in each inventory and one replacement in its own bank; foodTarget=1. eatBelow=0 retains Gatherer's automatic half-base-HP threshold (crates/script/src/gatherer/runner.rs:1860-1863). Static safety does not prove dynamic threats or live yield and bank rates.
